reviewStatus: Read-only assistant-reviewed graphical contact proxy; no human artistic or anatomical approval
floorCoordinate: continuous center of chosen source-cell row: integer row index + 0.5; not its lower edge
scope: 14 grounded pages only; vertical translation only; all canopy and aerial_boost excluded
targetRationale: Common native-cell floor near the standing idle baseline, with half-pixel center so all vertical shifts are integral and source pixels need no resampling. Existing horizontal layout stays fixed.
assumptions: Lowest broad opaque silhouette row is a visible floor-contact proxy, not a certified anatomical contact or world collision.
Toe, palm, bent knee, and side-of-body contact may contribute depending on pose; the proxy does not distinguish these semantically.
The reviewer must verify representative source poses and residual anatomy at A/B seams.
Translations preserve all internal pixels and anatomy, but do not fix differences in body scale, hand/foot spacing, or action phase.
This candidate was explicitly adopted for draft metadata-only use after assistant visual review.
No gameplay timing, movement, hitboxes, collision, IK, animation enum, or binding is created.
